broadcast-writes.boundary: WhatsApp with approved templates and numbers in the same portfolio. The server checks balance, limits and permissions when sending. Budget changes and channel connections are managed elsewhere.

broadcast-writes.readonly: You have viewing access. Actions require permissions for campaigns and the selected channel.
broadcast-writes.name: Name
broadcast-writes.no_channels: No eligible numbers with management permission for this template.

broadcast-writes.write_error: Could not confirm the operation. Close and refresh before retrying to check whether it was saved.
